title: Learning on-the-fly quasi-stationarity diagnostics from low-dimensional surrogates
abstract: arXiv:2610.36078v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Accelerated dynamics methods, such as parallel replica dynamics, require estimates of the decorrelation time, after which a process trapped in one of its metastable states is distributed according to the quasi-stationary distribution (QSD).   In a method proposed by Binder, Leli\`evre and Simpson, decorrelation times are defined by coupling a particle approximation of the non-linear conditioned probability flow of the process with MCMC-inspired diagnostics.   We explore an alternative to MCMC diagnostics, based on coarse-graining of non-linear probability flows and simulation-based inference.   We first develop a coarse-graining framework for killed Markov jump processes conditioned on survival, proving uniform-in-time, non-asymptotic estimates approximating the non-linear probability flow of   the true process by the non-linear flow of a surrogate process, defined with a collective variable. translated_title: 从低维代理模型中即时学习准平稳性诊断方法
translated_abstract: 加速动力学方法（如并行副本动力学）需要对去相关时间的估计，在此时间之后，被困于某一亚稳态的过程将按照准平稳分布（QSD）进行分布。在Binder、Lelièvre和Simpson提出的方法中，去相关时间是通过将过程非线性条件概率流的粒子近似与受MCMC启发的诊断量耦合来定义的。我们探索了一种替代MCMC诊断的方法，该方法基于非线性概率流的粗粒化与基于仿真的推断。我们首先为以存活为条件的被吸收马尔可夫跳过程建立了一个粗粒化框架，证明了随时间一致的非渐近估计，该估计利用由集体变量定义的代理过程的非线性流来逼近真实过程的非线性概率流。该框架不假设可逆性……（原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了一种基于非线性概率流粗粒化与基于仿真的推断的准平稳性诊断新方法，通过由低维集体变量定义的代理过程即时学习去相关时间估计，以替代传统的MCMC诊断方法。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes an alternative to MCMC-inspired quasi-stationarity diagnostics by learning decorrelation-time estimates on-the-fly through coarse-graining of non-linear probability flows and simulation-based inference, using a low-dimensional surrogate process defined by a collective variable.
